Penalizing this as a failure is too strict for a valid space bar. I will treat this as a pass for alignment purposes, noting the taxonomy imprecision.
2. 'Underside connects to a long stabilizer bar mechanism': Router marked `is_testable: false`. Correct; internal mechanics are occluded.
3. All other checkpoints (Length, Surface, Label, Position, Material, Context) were correctly marked as present and testable.
The Router was not lenient; if anything, it was overly literal on the first checkpoint.
